name: quests.stepExec
why_off: Four steps ported to the generic step executor: the Cain scroll (Tree of Inifuss click and pick-up), Akara reading the scroll (talk step, card stepexec2), the Horadric Staff transmute and placing the Staff in the orifice (Act 2 rows); the scenarios cain.scroll.stepexec, cain.read.stepexec, drill.act2.assemble.stepexec and drill.act2.duriel.stepexec have not run on the lab yet.
enable_criteria: Scenarios cain.scroll.stepexec, cain.read.stepexec, drill.act2.assemble.stepexec and drill.act2.duriel.stepexec green 2 of 3 runs each on the lab, then flip on one sandbox with a 24 h watch and auto-revert on a hard breach (docs/process/dark-launch.md); the old handler is deleted after the watch.
